beats.text: In Moldova, women are 55.4% of workers. In Afghanistan, just 6.8%.
Moldova is the world's highest, where women are a majority of those working.
It counts everyone 15 or older who supplies labor for goods and services.
Afghanistan is the world's lowest. Moldova has 8.1 times the share Afghanistan does.
The largest economies sit in the middle. USA: 45.6%. China: 45.4%.
The UK, Nigeria, and Russia sit higher. UK: 47.8%. Nigeria: 48.4%. Russia: 48.8%.
